questions.q:
Match the following:

A. Beautifuli. Superlative degree
B. Smartestii. Comparative degree
C. More handsomeiii. Positive degree
questions.s:
Most adjectives form their comparatives by the addition of - r or - er, and their superlative by the addition of - st or - est (depending on the spelling) to the positive. Here, the suffix 'est' has been used with the word 'smart' making it a superlative degree.

In some cases, adjectives (usually having more than two syllables in the spelling) form their comparative by using the adverb more with the positive, and the superlative by using the adverb most with the positive. Here 'more' has been used with the word 'handsome'. So, it forms a comparative degree.

Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q:
Tarika dances swiftest than others and misses all the steps.

questions.s: When comparing two things, the correct comparative form of "swift" is "swifter" (not "swiftest," which is the superlative form).

questions.q: The conclusion of the experiment was most final, there were no further tests needed.
o: The conclusion of the experiment
was most final, there
were no further tests needed
questions.s:
The sentence contains an error. Adjectives like ‘interior’, ‘exterior’, ‘ulterior’, ‘major’, ‘minor’, ‘empty’, ‘excellent’, ‘circular’, ‘extreme’, ‘chief’, ‘entire’, ‘complete’, ‘perfect’, ‘final’, ‘last’, ‘unique’, ‘universal’, ‘round’, ‘square’, ‘triangular’, ‘eternal’, ‘everlasting’, ‘ideal’, ‘absolute’, ‘impossible’ and ‘supreme’, ‘free’, and ‘vacant’ are not used in comparative degree or superlative degree. Therefore, "most final" is incorrect.

The corrected sentence would be: "The conclusion of the experiment was final; there were no further tests needed."

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The more harder / you work, / the better / it will be.
questions.s:
The correct answer is 'The more harder'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
  • Here, 'The harder' should be used instead of 'The more harder'.
  • Using double comparatives is an error.
    • Example: Emma is smarter than Jason.
  • ​Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.
     

​Correct Sentence: The harder you work, the better it will be. 

Hinglish

  • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
  • यहाँ 'The more harder' के स्थान पर 'The harder' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
  • 'Double comparatives' का उपयोग करना एक error है।
    • ​Example: Emma is smarter than Jason.
  • अत: सही उत्तर Option 1 है।
